get.summary: Returns the timing and playback curves for a Smart Fade between two songs.
get.description: Requires sonicSimilarity extension version 2. Plans a transition from the currently playing song to the next, including playback rate, loudness normalization, volume and EQ automation. Cue inputs are song-relative seconds and may be adjusted; use the returned positions. Request early enough to load the audio and schedule the returned start. Without compatible beats, return a crossfade when possible. Standard failed subsonic-response codes: 10 for missing parameters, 70 for unknown or inaccessible songs, 0 for invalid cue positions or other planning failures. If the plan fails, arrives late, or cannot be executed, use a client crossfade at the queue cues.

parameters.name: fromSongId
parameters.description: The ID of the currently playing song (from).

parameters.name: toSongId
parameters.description: The ID of the next song (to).

parameters.name: fadeOut
parameters.description: Suggested outgoing end position in seconds from getSonicSmartFade. Positive and no later than the song end.

parameters.name: fadeIn
parameters.description: Suggested incoming entry position in seconds from getSonicSmartFade. Nonnegative and before the song end.
